descricao_original: This electron micrograph shows a mid-anaphase cell in which the chromosomes have separated and are attached to microtubules of the spindle apparatus. Neither the nuclear envelope nor nucleolus is present. While the nuclear envelope fragments into vesicles, remnants of the RER remain intact. 5000x
